title: CloudflareInternalHttpContractBundle

ObjectAuthorizeRequest.title: ObjectAuthorizeRequest
ObjectAuthorizeRequest.$comment: Exactly one of the current credential (first presentation) or the C#-issued SessionBinding is supplied, as for the run authorize port. The credential is a bounded secret that is never logged.

ServiceObjectGrant.title: ServiceObjectGrant
ServiceObjectGrant.$comment: The grant lasts at most 60 seconds from issuance and never outlives the current owner lease; the record carries no issuance time, so lifetime and lease checks are owner-side rules covered by the offline oracle vectors. No raw R2 key or credential appears in a grant.

WorkerObjectJobRequest.title: WorkerObjectJobRequest
WorkerObjectJobRequest.$comment: Typed bounded metadata for GET/PUT /internal/objects/v1/jobs/{grantId}. The Worker requires service HMAC plus a matching, unexpired owner grant and accepts no ambient customer bearer, arbitrary object key or raw R2 credential; every range and part is reauthorized through job-authorize.

WorkerObjectJobReadRequest.title: WorkerObjectJobReadRequest
WorkerObjectJobReadRequest.$comment: Object bytes are the streaming HTTP response body and are never embedded in this JSON metadata.

WorkerObjectJobWriteRequest.title: WorkerObjectJobWriteRequest
WorkerObjectJobWriteRequest.$comment: The part body is streamed, SHA-256 and length verified before any receipt is recorded; one part is at most 8 MiB and the declared hash travels in the signed request body-hash position.

WorkerDeleteRequest.title: WorkerDeleteRequest
WorkerDeleteRequest.$comment: Callable only through the existing account-scoped Workspace owner deletion job; a workspaceId in this body is data, never caller-selected authority. At most 200 exact targets per page, no wildcard namespace delete.

InferenceOutcomeRequest.title: InferenceOutcomeRequest
InferenceOutcomeRequest.$comment: A complete outcome carries its validated result; usage may be absent and then records costUnconfirmed owner-side. An interrupted, refused or unknown outcome never publishes a complete result.

InferenceLateOutcomeRequest.title: InferenceLateOutcomeRequest
InferenceLateOutcomeRequest.$comment: Exact inference-outcome fields plus the original epoch and recovery generation. Only the current authenticated reconciliation service may use this stale-fence evidence port; it never publishes stale Search output or creates a customer debit.

WebSearchRequest.title: WebSearchRequest
WebSearchRequest.$comment: First-party search profile: strict safe search and offset 0 are fixed adapter constants, not request fields. Frozen query consent is committed by C# cloud-tool admission before this port is invoked, so no consent reference crosses to the Worker.

PartReceipt.title: PartReceipt
PartReceipt.$comment: Same shape as the public PartReceipt; the ETag is an opaque R2 value and is never interpreted as SHA-256.
